notes.title: Somber Echoes Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
The wait is over! From the creators of Moons of Madness, [b]Somber Echoes[/b], the atmospheric Metroidvania that merges ancient Greek myth with deep-space horror, is now available on Steam. Players can finally embark aboard the Atromitos, a vast Greco-Roman spacecraft infested with creatures from a dark and mysterious realm. 

To celebrate the launch, we are bringing you a bundle with Moons of Madness & Somber Echoes. If you already own either game, or plan on buying both together, you'll get a 10% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49470/Cosmic_Tragedies_Bundle/


[b]Experience the Universe on the Brink of Collapse[/b]
Take control of [b]Adrestia[/b], the lone warrior resurrected to stop her twin sister, Harmonia, from unraveling the fabric of the universe. As you delve into the labyrinthine halls of the Atromitos, uncover lost lore, master fluid combat mechanics, and conquer sectors teeming with nightmarish foes. Each step forward unveils new secrets, challenges, and cosmic powers that redefine the journey.

[b]What Awaits You in Somber Echoes?[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Greco-Roman Sci-Fi World:[/b] A unique mix of mythological themes and futuristic design.
[*] [b]Classic Metroidvania Gameplay:[/b] Unlock abilities, retrace paths, and uncover hidden areas.
[*] [b]Dynamic Combat:[/b] Engage in skillful battles, parrying, and striking against formidable adversaries.
[*] [b]Immersive Biomes:[/b] Explore distinct areas aboard the Atromitos, from decaying coliseums to eerie laboratories. [/list]
[b]A New Benchmark for Indie Metroidvanias[/b]
Developed in collaboration between [b]Rock Pocket Games[/b] (Norway) and [b]Lav Games[/b] (Serbia), and published by Finland’s [b]Bonus Stage Publishing[/b], Somber Echoes represents a bold step forward for indie gaming. Its intricate design, gripping story, and fusion of mythology with science fiction set it apart in the genre.

[b]Join the Journey Today[/b]
Somber Echoes is ready to challenge your skills, immerse you in its captivating world, and leave you yearning for more.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299290/Somber_Echoes/

notes.title: New game from the creators of Moons of Madness
notes.content:
[b]From the creators of Moons of Madness comes Somber Echoes—A Dark-Fantasy Metroidvania Steeped in Ancient Greek Myth—and Set in Deep Space.[/b]

Brace yourself for the looming cosmic threat aboard the once-glorious Greco-Roman spacecraft Atromitos. Now infested with horrifying creatures from an unknown realm, the ship sets the stage for Somber Echoes, a dark-fantasy Metroidvania releasing on January 21. To mark the occasion, Somber Echoes has unveiled a brand-new teaser trailer, spotlighting the game’s moody sci-fi atmosphere and mythological undertones.

Watch trailer:

[previewyoutube=S6q3tLKcPBU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A Universe at Risk[/h3]
In the wake of a devastating cataclysm, a mysterious power revives Adrestia—the only one capable of stopping her twin sister, Harmonia, from tearing the universe apart. As Adrestia, you must master swift acrobatic combat, uncover forgotten lore, and navigate labyrinthine districts that each present unique challenges, from decaying coliseums to eerie research labs.

[h3]Key Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Greco-Roman Sci-Fi Setting:[/b] Experience an evocative blend of ancient mythology and futuristic design.
[*][b]Metroidvania Exploration:[/b] Unlock new skills to revisit old paths, discovering hidden areas and unraveling secrets that shape your destiny.
[*][b]Intense Combat:[/b] Hone your parries and strikes to cut down monstrous foes and harness cosmic powers.
[*][b]Distinct Biomes:[/b] Every sector of the Atromitos offers its own visual flair and nightmarish adversaries.
[/list]
[h3]Announcement Teaser Trailer[/h3]
Get a taste of the dread and determination driving Somber Echoes—check out the official teaser trailer for a glimpse of its brooding environments and visceral gameplay:
[url=https://youtu.be/S6q3tLKcPBU]Watch the Teaser Trailer Here[/url]

[b]And make sure to wishlist the game on Steam:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299290/Somber_Echoes/

notes.title: Cyrano Story: Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214430/461b3df55e3a8006e9115ed867c3fe740c96078b.jpg[/img]

[h2]LISTEN! Listen to the voices as they whisper! What is your fear?[/h2]

A support ship inbound to a Mars research base, the Cyrano's crew expected a routine operation. Well, as routine a mission to a secret facility built by the shadowy Orochi corporation could be.  Suddenly, a ship malfunction occurs, and the crew begins to exhibit symptoms of an otherworldly infection.  

What befell the crew of the Cyrano? It's up to you to uncover their fate.

Cyrano Story is an intense, interactive narrative experience that has you answer to an unknown force - its enigmas unlocked by delving into real-world research and history. Based on your reactions, will this mysterious entity guide you to true cosmic wisdom, or infinite madness?

The nature of fear itself awaits in Cyrano Story, the alternate-reality puzzle game set in the cosmic horror of Moons of Madness and Secret World Legends!  

Now available!  Play for FREE now for a chance to win a copy of Moons of Madness on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250870/Cyrano_Story/

notes.title: Moons of Madness Update 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Moons of Madness has been updated to version 1.02.  Here's what's changed or fixed:

[list]
[*] Minor fixes and improvements to collision and geometry
[*] Minor fixes and improvements to various visual issues
[*] Minor fixes for voice lines triggering incorrectly
[*] Fixed taking phantom filth damage when walking through a door in Cave of Madness
[*] Weather conditions made more consistent throughout Trailblazer Alpha
[*] Cleaned up some issues with the Stalker
[*] Fixed a typo in someone’s scribbled notes. Because when your mind is being consumed by the void, you’d better be able to write everything clearly.
[/list]

notes.content:

[h1][b][url=https://www.gameshedge.com/review-moons-of-madness/]GamesHedge.com[/url][/b][/h1]
"Moons of Madness combines two of the best settings for any horror title, Mars and Lovecraftian Horror. During the calm, Moons of Madness plays like an excellent exploration game while during the horror bits, nothing will stop the madness from tearing you from limb to limb."

8.9/10

"Moons of Madness is a wonderfully chilling outing that blends horror and sci-fi to excellent effect, delivering a palpable sense of dread."

8/10

[h1][b][url=https://www.pcinvasion.com/moons-of-madness-review-fly-me-to-the-moons/]PCInvasion.com[/url][/b][/h1]
"[...]Moons of Madness‘ story is very strong. The writing and dialogue are both excellent, and the plot kept me invested for its entire runtime."

8/10

notes.title: Moons of Madness Update: October 24, 2019
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Reduced volume of intro videos
[*] Fixed missing text characters in Polish localization
[*] Fixed various locations where player’s movement becomes stuck
[*] Fixed various instances where player is stuck interacting with an object
[*] Objective Markers now only show up if ‘Markers’ or ‘Markers and Paths’ is selected (from Settings -> Waypoints)
[*] Shane now correctly remembers if he’s found his first Water Reclaimer part.  Memory is a construct, after all.
[*] Numbing agent no longer causes adverse effects on administering user
[*] Greenhouse doors now correctly show their status after loading from a checkpoint
[*] Added checkpoint to start of Power of the Sun
[*] Fixed checkpoint in Chapter 3 (no spoilers!)
[*] Fixed/enhanced various small graphical details
[/list]

notes.title: Escape the Thing in the Mist in this brand new Gameplay Video
notes.content:
Halloween is going to be all about Lovecraftian horror on Mars this year. We're drawing closer and closer to the release of Moons of Madness! 

Take a look at the brand-new gameplay video with a sneak peek of what you can expect when you encounter a creature only known  as the Thing in the Mist:

[previewyoutube=U_le8QkmA4I;full][/previewyoutube]

The system requirements were also revealed today:

[h1]Minimum system requirements:[/h1]
[b]CPU:[/b] Intel Core i5-760 or equivalent / AMD Athlon X4 740 or equivalent
[b]GPU:[/b] GeForce GTX 460 or MX150 / Radeon R7 260X
[b]RAM:[/b] 4 GB
[b]Disk space:[/b] Around 15 GB
[b]OS:[/b] Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10 x64

[h1]Recommended system requirements:[/h1]
[b]CPU:[/b] Intel Core i7-2600K or equivalent / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or equivalent
[b]GPU:[/b] GeForce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580
[b]RAM:[/b] 8 GB
[b]Disk space:[/b] Around 15 GB
[b]OS:[/b] Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10 x64

In Moons of Madness you play as Shane Newehart, chief engineer on a research facility on Mars – and after awakening from a disconcerting dream, you are about to find out that reality is far more terrifying than even your worst nightmare. You will have to rely on your problem-solving skills, your calm and your ability to run and hide, if you are to have any hope of survival.

Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist so you'll be notified when it goes on sale:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1012840/Moons_of_Madness/

notes.title: Solve the Moons of Madness ARG and win a trip to NASA
notes.content:
LISTEN! Listen to the voices as they whisper! What is your fear?

Discover the fate of the spaceship Cyrano in the Moons of Madness Alternate Reality Game (ARG) and delve into the nature of fear itself on [url=https://cyranostory.com/]Cyranostory.com[/url]. Funcom has teamed up with ARG experts Alice & Smith to create a unique and eerie experience leading up to the launch of Moons of Madness on October 22nd.

Intrepid players might find themselves greatly rewarded for their efforts! Funcom and Alice & Smith are giving out 2000 keys for Moons of Madness, The Park and The Black Watchmen to players who manage to solve all the intricate puzzles.

[b]When the final seal of the ARG opens on the 25th of October, you can enter a drawing to win a trip to visit a NASA space center, provided you’ve solved all the seals of course. [/b]

This grand prize includes tickets for two people to Space Center Houston, including lunch with an astronaut, a level 9 CIP Tour, round trip air transportation, and hotel accommodations for three nights; all provided by Funcom Oslo AS*.

[h1]Go to [url=https://cyranostory.com/]Cyranostory.com[/url] to play the ARG.[/h1]
